notes: Where models live: Files > Models shows each project's hosting (Forma cloud model or folder) and opens it, even from an empty Revit ("open ROXX22CO212 arch model"). NWC export set once for everyone: for each 3D view with NWC in its name, pick its file name and Forma location(s); saved in the model (Sync with Central to share) and Forma paths work on every user's PC. Shared team folder: create "Bob Team" in a Forma project. Markup tools for captures, Enter sends, toolbar arrows, icons and tooltips. Close all Revit windows before installation. Unsigned build; test on model copies.
